name: ui_open_view
description: Open one of the workspace views at the user's desk; one view shows at a time. cad = 3D modeling (the CAD design on the desk, its drawing, panel and versions), code = the code editor, ml = machine learning (training data and runs), messages = the messenger; none closes the open view. Call this only when the user asks for a view. If it returns an error, tell the user (usually: sit down at the desk first).
